findings.description: The bucket has no acl attribute set (comment confirms it is public), meaning it defaults to being publicly accessible, exposing its contents including the customer master file to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket (including sensitive customer data) are not encrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: The customer-master.xlsx object, which likely contains sensitive customer data, is stored in aws_s3_bucket.data, a bucket that is both publicly accessible and unencrypted, directly exposing this data to unauthorized parties.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so financial data stored here is not encrypted at rest, risking exposure if underlying storage or backups are compromised.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving operational data unencrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving data science datasets unencrypted at rest.
